snippet.title: Sizeable - Switch, PS5, Xbox Consoles Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sizeable is out now on consoles! 🐢
Play it now on Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One!

Shrink the world, grow the objects, and uncover the sweet little secrets hiding inside each cozy diorama. No timers, no fail states — just gentle, feel-good puzzling at your own pace.

Ported and Published on Consoles by Alchemy Games. Developed and published on PC by Sander Ambroos and Business Goose Studios.
